events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $4.47 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
F4 establishes one off-route segment (17:37–17:50, 5.85 km driven vs 2.68 km optimal, +3.17 km) [F4], so a route deviation exists under RD-1 and must be tested against RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 [RD-1][RD-6]. The driver's traffic defence fails: the only traffic records are speed band 4 on PIE and CTE [F12][F13] and no incident at all was recorded [F14], and a speed band alone cannot exempt a segment in the MVP [RD-4]. No prior driver route proposal with rider agreement appears in the chat [F9][F10], so RD-5 does not exempt the segment [RD-5].

The pivotal question is RD-3. The rider's message named no place — "a 7-Eleven on the way" [F9] — and the driver's own statement confirms he unilaterally picked "the one I know" [F11]. The car stopped 5306 m from the pickup and 4755 m from the drop-off, not at a pickup or drop-off point [F2], which is consistent with an excursion off the optimal corridor rather than a stop lying on the way. Under RD-3(b), a rider who asks only to "stop a moment" without naming a location does not consent to the driver's chosen route change, and the driver did not disclose the location beforehand [F9][F11]; the extra kilometres of that segment are therefore not exempt [RD-3].

Because this is a metered RydeTAXI trip [F8], the deviation enters the fare and the refund is the non-exempt segment's extra distance at the trip's per-kilometre rate [RD-2]. RD-2 in this dataset is bounded by the tool-computed sum of extra_km of non-exempt segments (3.17 km) times $1.4098/km, i.e. 3.17 km × $1.4098/km = $4.4691 → $4.47 [F4][F8][RD-2]. The waiting component is treated separately: RydeTAXI waiting is charged by the meter's time unit [F6], which RD-3(c) leaves unreversed [RD-3], so the $1.08 waiting charge stands and is excluded from the refund [F6][F8].

The profile facts are not determinative: the rider shows no upheld disputes [F16] and the driver shows 386 trips and 2 upheld disputes but route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F17], so RD-6's precondition is not met and no account flag is added [RD-6].

The deciding point: the detour added about 3.17 km of driving beyond the best route, and when you asked to stop at "a 7-Eleven on the way" you didn't name a location, so the extra distance isn't exempt. The metered waiting charge stays, since waiting time is chargeable on RydeTAXI trips. Nothing else is needed from you — the voucher will be applied to your account.

DRIVER: We've reviewed this trip and found that part of the route you took wasn't on the way. The deciding point: you drove about 3.17 km further than the best route, and because the rider asked only to stop "on the way" without naming a place, the detour isn't exempt. No refund is being issued to you, and this route deviation is recorded on your file. Traffic conditions recorded for this trip don't exempt the segment. This is a note on your account, not a suspension — keep to the recommended route on future trips.
